item.description:
Youth and Community Development | Procurement | Award | $6.5M | Vendor: Bronx House Inc. | Flagged: Contract value ≥ $1M In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Bronx House Inc. a $6,466,905 contract for COMPASS Center Based Elementary after-school, summer and holiday programs for elementary students, selected from competing proposals drawn from a pre-qualified list.

COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.

Health Research Incorporated (HRI), who is designated as a research institute and membership corporation affiliated with the NYS Department of Health (NYS DOH), will provide DOHMH with support, supplement or extend the functions and programs of NYS DOH, for speciation & drug resistance testing. Under this sole source contract, the NYS DOH Wadsworth Center, Mycobacteriology Laboratory will perform Tuberculosis (TB) molecular testing services, including deletion analysis, targeted next generation sequencing (tNGS), and whole genome sequencing (WGS) to perform to ensure rapid, accurate, and comprehensive TB diagnostic and genotyping capacity.

item.title: Non-Exclusive Use of City-Owned Trademarks on Merchandise
item.description:
Small Business Services | Procurement | Award | $30K | Vendor: Ten Three Graphics | Flagged: Sole-source / non-competitive In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Small Business Services awarded Ten Three Graphics, LLC, a Connecticut company, a sole-source license to use city-owned trademarks on merchandise for 2026 through 2028, with a $30,000 guaranteed minimum royalty and a 15% royalty on retail sales.

NYC Tourism + Conventions, Inc., on behalf of the New York City Department of Small Business Services (SBS), has awarded a Sole Source License Agreement (License), pursuant to Section 1-16 of the Concession Rules of the City of New York, to Ten Three Graphics, LLC (Licensee), whose address is 26 Great Pond Rd, South Glastonbury, CT 06073, for the non-exclusive use of City-owned trademarks on merchandise.

The Agreement shall commence January 1, 2026, and continue through December 31, 2028, unless sooner terminated pursuant to the terms and conditions of the License.

During the initial term, Licensee shall pay to NYC Tourism + Conventions a royalty equal to fifteen percent (15%) of Net Sales when sold at Retail, as well as a one-time guaranteed minimum royalty of thirty thousand dollars ($30,000), payable on or before December 31, 2028.

The City, in its sole discretion, shall have the option to renew the License Agreement on substantially the same terms and conditions for a period of two (2) additional years, from January 1, 2029 through December 31, 2030.
